plan.title: Material PR to split-award purchase orders

steps.note: Enable split awarding across vendors.
Enable sourcing projects for the PR-created event.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.

args.title: Material PR Split Award Reverse Auction

steps.note: Provide the required event title.
Set and commit the 30-minute bidding duration.

args.goal: On the single-stage auction create screen, set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes and add one required Terms and Conditions clause; stop on the create screen showing both saved configurations.

steps.note: Set the required evaluation period and add the required T&C clause, which no single domain step fully expresses together.
Use the product's mapped QA vendors rather than inviting real suppliers.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's bid at 100 through the supported vendor-bidding flow.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower bid at 90 through the second vendor bidding flow.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify the lowest bid ranks first, covering Vendor B's expected Rank 1 outcome.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed, bid event.
Allocate six units of the PR line to the lower bidder, Vendor B.
Allocate the remaining four units to Vendor A.
Verify the full line is split across both vendors and the proposal value is 6×90 plus 4×100.
Create the proposal after the split allocation.
Submit the split-award proposal for approval.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved split award for material PR

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete the approved award and create one purchase order per awarded vendor.
Verify the resulting purchase orders contain the two awarded portions.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's post-bidding history.
Open the History tab after the event has completed.
Verify this plan's auction appears in event history.
